description: Pre-flight migration assessment. Dry-runs every table + view migration inside a transaction that rolls back. Returns a consolidated DataFrame with status (auto_convertible/needs_review/will_fail), complexity heuristic (simple/medium/complex), specific dialect-quirk markers, and proposed target DDL. The 'what would happen if I ran this tomorrow?' view.

inputs.description: Reads source DDL + attempts dry-run on target

outputs.description: Per-object assessment: object_type, schema_name, name, target_name, status, complexity, dialect_markers, reason, proposed_target_ddl

source_connection_env_var.description: Env var with source SQLAlchemy URL
source_connection_env_var.label: Source Connection Env Var

target_connection_env_var.description: Env var with target SQLAlchemy URL
target_connection_env_var.label: Target Connection Env Var

source_type.description: Source DB dialect: postgres / mysql / mssql / oracle / db2 / snowflake / redshift
source_type.label: Source Type

schemas.description: Source schemas to assess (default: all non-system)
schemas.label: Source Schemas

include_patterns.description: fnmatch-style glob patterns against qualified object names
include_patterns.label: Include Patterns

target_schema.description: Override target schema for the proposed target names
target_schema.label: Target Schema Override

table_replacements.description: FK reference / view body rewrites (old qualified name → new)
table_replacements.label: Table/FK Replacements

function_replacements.description: Case-insensitive whole-word substitutions applied to CHECK expressions + view bodies (e.g. {'NVL': 'COALESCE'})
function_replacements.label: Function Replacements

assess_constraints.description: Also assess CHECK/UNIQUE/PK/FK as ALTER TABLE (data-first style). Default false — DDL-first is preferred.
assess_constraints.label: Assess Constraints (Data-First)

name: Database Migration Assessment
